target.name: Annual national Cantril ladder mean
target.sourceRequired: Official intentionally public annual World Happiness Report map data; three-year averages forbidden

caveats: Limited preselected eight-country demonstration (USA, IND, DEU, GBR, BRA, JPN, ZAF, CHN); pooled results do not represent the full world panel.
Latest-vintage retrospective reconstruction; not real-time forecasts. Annual survey year is not release date.
Previously studied outcome periods are not untouched holdouts.
Conditional replay uses realized target-year drivers; these are conditional one-year reconstructions, not deployable forecasts.
Rolling forecasts use data dated at or before t-1, but source revisions can contain later information.
World Bank drivers differ from the WHR six-factor model and do not include same-survey social variables.
Results do not identify causal effects or validate post-AI scenarios.
Annual targets are public-chart transcriptions rounded to three decimals, not a bulk original Gallup annual data release; chart extraction and limited validation add measurement risk.

modes.label: Conditional historical replay — actual annual drivers, frozen 2016 coefficients
modes.features: realized x_t permitted; no target y_t used

modes.label: Rolling one-year-ahead — projected drivers using data through t-1
modes.features: xhat_t = x_(t-1) + 0.5 * (x_(t-1)-x_(t-2)); no realized target-year features

targetCollection.targetPrecision: Three decimal places displayed by official public annual-score tooltips
targetCollection.collection: Read visible annual chart SVG circle coordinates and axis tick positions after selecting Annual score on each official country page. Converted linear axes to year and ladder score, correcting the SVG axis half-pixel stroke alignment, rounded to the dashboard's three decimals. Verified latest-year values against the visible annual tooltip for all eight countries, plus US 2024 and previously read US historical points. No hidden application state, API-token construction, private API or gated download used. Eight-country set predetermined; missing years not filled.
